subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should this PR be ported as the scoped final-answer-candidate Activity slice, folded into the broader native Codex progress work tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039, or closed in favor of a fresh current-main implementation?
rationale: The code idea has proof, but current main moved the Activity owner and the remaining choice is whether maintainers want this narrow UI surface or a broader native Codex progress design first.

options.title: Port the scoped slice
options.body: Rebase and move answer-candidate parsing/rendering into the current ui/src/pages/activity owner while preserving channel-progress suppression.

options.title: Fold into broader progress UX
options.body: Hold or close this branch and implement answer candidates together with the full native Codex progress surface for the canonical issue.

options.title: Close for fresh implementation
options.body: Close this conflicting branch and invite a new current-main PR if maintainers prefer not to repair the old branch.

recommendation.title: Port the scoped slice
recommendation.body: Rebase and move answer-candidate parsing/rendering into the current ui/src/pages/activity owner while preserving channel-progress suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent Codex app-server history and is the best available owner in the evidence for the cross-runtime product decision.
